column1: # zu_tone.tsv — Zulu word→tone lexicon. Word→tone facts extracted from Wiktionary via
# kaikki.org (https://kaikki.org/dictionary/Zulu/) and re-encoded in our own H/L/F/R
# notation. A word's tone is a linguistic FACT, not copyrightable expression — credited
# here as provenance, not as a licensed work. Nguni tone is not derivable from spelling,
# so the L2S overlays it from here (build-tone-lexicon.ts).
# Pattern is one code per vowel nucleus: H high · L low · F falling · R rising. All-Low
# words are omitted (privative-H convention). Out-of-lexicon words are left untoned.
